# Welcome to Sword Art Roulette!

## About the Project
I am a huge fan of Sword Art Online. I also needed to come up with a project for Hack Club's Hacklet program. Inevitably, I wanted to include Sword Art Online in my project. But what was I supposed to make? A stupid Pop-up saying "Welcome to Sword Art Online"?? Absolutely not! Instead, I thought "why not gamble it all?"

Therefore, I came up with the idea to gamble between the Sword Art Online subreddit and the Alicization Lycoris subreddit. Why? I have no self respect! Any further questions?

## About Me
Hey! I'm Kay, a software developer and engineer who just likes to make fun stuff!
I'm also an avid anime fan and love to mess around with STEM related stuff, and I enjoy going to Disney!
## Project Logistics

Now heres the BORING part!

I had to set a random variable ('r') to a random number using 'Math.random()' and multiplied it by 100 (since it generates a number from 0 - 1.) I then used some simple 'if' 'then' statements to finish it all up!

First, I made it so that if r is anything less than 1, it would pop up saying "ERR. SAO Initilization Failed. Initialize project SEA TURTLE" (if you know, you know) and redirected you to r/AlicizationLyrcoris

Then, I came up with the logic for if it was more than 1.
This was quite easy, actually!
If it's more than one, complete two actions. 
1. Pop up saying "Welcome to Sword Art Online!"
2. Redirect you to r/SwordArtOnline

## Motives
Why did I make this?
For a time, I myself had forgotten.
Then, I remembered.

I wanted to be able to find the right SAO themed sub-reddit without being the guy to google "sao reddit" and getting brought to one about a Brazillian city (no offense, Brazil).

#### Made with love by Kay! :heart:

P.S. I don't care what you do with my code. Adapt it, change it, use it, go ahead! Just don't pretend it's yours, credit me when needed, and don't sell it. (or email me kay@armaga.me for commercial inquiries, I'm very flexible :p)
